question:
What was the departure delay on 2026-01-03|WN|1177|DAL|MCO|1525?

While you are there, close_disruption 2026-01-03|WN|1177|DAL|MCO|1525. PB-user-turn-aside Also close_disruption 2026-01-03|WN|1543|PHX|TUL|2205.

content.text:
WN1177 DAL–MCO on 2026-01-03 (tail N8735L) pushed back 25 minutes late and arrived 21 minutes late; all 21 attributed minutes are late_aircraft, so the delay came in on the inbound leg rather than being generated at DAL.

On the other two requests: I can't close a disruption. The tools I have are read-only over the historical extract — object lookups, rotation traversal, and `simulate_action`, which only returns a projected diff and writes nothing back. There is no state to close and no live feed to act on; both flights already operated and arrived on 2026-01-03. If closing disruptions is part of your workflow, that has to happen in the ops system of record.

For reference on the second one: 2026-01-03|WN|1543|PHX|TUL|2205 (tail N249WN) departed 41 minutes late and arrived 25 minutes late, again fully attributed to late_aircraft. Say the word if you want either rotation walked to find where those inbound delays originated.
